sources.fullCitation: Ilja Livschakoff Tanz-Orchester, with German refrain vocal by L. Monosson. “Süße Mamsell, denkst du noch an das kleine Hotel.” Tango; words by Fritz Rotter; music by Bronisław Kaper. Grammophon B 51043, Bestell-Nr. 23179, side 2, n.d. [not before 1930]. Label visible via Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv online upload.
sources.title: Süße Mamsell, denkst du noch an das kleine Hotel
sources.creator: Ilja Livschakoff Tanz-Orchester; L. Monosson, vocal refrain

sources.fullCitation: Karkoff-Orchester mit Refraingesang. “In der Laubenkolonie.” Foxtrot aus dem Tonfilm „In der Laubenkolonie“; label credit “(Kaper)”. Derby D.O. 5710 a, marked “Nur für Deutschland” and carrying the B.I.E.M. mark, n.d. The uploader describes it as a 20 cm disc issued in 1930. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload. Accessed 20 August 2026.
sources.title: In der Laubenkolonie — Derby D.O. 5710 a
